CLAUDE-G23LJ-V6-A1 is honoured; recordedInputs grows from 11 to 16 entries and both corpus v3 review verdicts return. Nothing is invented: 24 occurrences of 'platform' and zero platform names, every 64-hex string an accounted-for pin appearing exactly twice, no fixture payload and no observation bytes.
